name: Custom Built Cabinetry
old_description: We are a family run cabinet shop servicing Oahu since 1991. We are proud to say that we get the job done every single time, no exceptions. Our style is based on traditional Hawaiian plantation with a classy modern functionality….
about:
Founded in 1991 in Kailua, on the island of Oahu, Custom Built Cabinetry operates as a family-run cabinet shop. The business was established to serve residential clients across Oahu with custom woodwork rooted in the islands' plantation heritage.

The shop handles the full cycle of custom cabinetry: design, fabrication, and installation. Projects range from kitchen cabinets and bath vanities to closet systems and entertainment centers. All casework is built from domestic Maple plywood treated for termite resistance, with Blum soft-close hardware on doors and drawers; particle board is not used.

Custom Built Cabinetry serves homeowners, condo owners, and renovation contractors on Oahu. Recent projects include a Hawaii Kai condo renovation encompassing kitchen, master and secondary baths, and an entertainment center, as well as numerous kitchen remodels for private residences.

The company emphasizes its 30 years of design experience and a style that blends traditional Hawaiian plantation aesthetics with modern functionality. It cites its material choices — termite-treated Maple ply and premium hardware — and a reputation for exceeding expectations as key differentiators.
